info.name: HajjCare Backend API - Layer A
info.description:
The eight auth endpoints the Flutter client calls (BACKEND_SPEC.md §3) and the RevenueCat webhook, each with the contract checks from CLAUDE.md §A9.

**Run it:** `docker compose up -d --build`, import this collection and `HajjCare-Environment.postman_environment.json`, select the environment, then Run collection (in order, no delay needed). Every run registers a fresh pilgrim.

- `baseUrl` ends in `/api/v1`; paths are appended verbatim.
- Reset codes are read from Mailpit (`mailpitUrl`, docker compose only). Against a server that sends real email, leave `mailpitUrl` empty and put the emailed code in `otpCode` by hand; folder 5 needs Mailpit.
- Only `/auth/me` carries an Authorization header. The webhook sends `rcWebhookSecret` as its Authorization value.
- Folder 2: a used refresh token keeps working, with no time limit, until one of its children is used.
- A collection-level test on every API response checks: no 404/403 under /auth, 409 only for email_taken, no 500, bare JSON object with camelCase keys.
